what_happened: Scene: layout/style 8 (olive cabinets, wood counters); knife (knife_8, black handle) lying diagonally in a drawer at the right; the board is 1.08 m away, so a base move is needed. Stage 0: the gripper first went into the drawer at the wrong spot and closed on air at 228 (knife out of the wrist view). From ~340 the knife was in the wrist view, but 340-1260 (~900 steps, 45 s) the gripper hovered just above it with the knife diagonal and the handle running out past the right finger pad, opening/closing nothing except a twitch to 0.06 at 1167 (on air). From 1268 it re-oriented so the knife ran vertically through the finger gap, closed at 1413 on the top of the handle next to the bolster, lifted 0.15 m (hold 1424-1448), and at ~1440-1456 the fingers shut (0.002) and the knife slid out and fell back into the drawer. With the gripper still closed the arm rose over the counter (1480-1560) and opened at 1568 over the empty counter, as if placing. The knife ended in the drawer 0.89 m from the board; the meat was never approached.
causal_chain: close on air in the drawer 228 -> hovered over the knife with the handle off-centre 340-1260 (~900 steps; stage 0 median 486 for the whole stage) -> re-aligned and grasped 1413 near the bolster -> knife slipped out ~1440 after a 0.15 m lift -> empty carry and open over the counter 1480-1568 -> timeout 1600 with the knife in the drawer
self_recovery: After the long hover it re-oriented the gripper and grasped (1413), but the grasp slipped; there was no time for another attempt.
official_criterion_notes: meat tipped_over_intervals from step 10 and tilt 65 deg at the end: the drumstick model's axis; the meat was never touched.

packet_facts: knife touch only from 1267; hold 1424-1448 lift 0.148 drop 0.151
knife end 0.89 m from the board, in the drawer

uncertain_about: Why the policy did not commit during the 900-step hover; the wrist view looks like a graspable handle near the right finger pad.
